blocks.title: Summary and outlook
blocks.content:
Summary and outlook
In this work we’ve discussed the inclusion of LIBEs eﬀects in the nucleons spectrum, ﬁnding
their masses and the diﬀerence 𝑀𝑛−𝑀𝑝.
The 𝑂(𝛼𝐸𝑀) and 𝑂( ˆ𝑚𝑑−ˆ𝑚𝑢
Λ𝑄𝐶𝐷) corrections have been taken into account using the RM123
method. Critical masses were ﬁxed by the PCAC Ward Identity in order to preserve the maximal
twist condition at LO. The physical masses are tuned using an hadronic scheme and the lattice
spacing is ﬁxed through 𝑀Ω−.
We worked in the electroquenched approximation and neglected QCD disconnected diagrams.
